story: It was decided before the stage that the general classification times would be taken at 3 km from the finish due to expected rain and slippery conditions. A five-man breakaway formed early but was caught before the second intermediate sprint, after which a new four-rider move went clear. Piotr Pękala rode solo for a while before Ahmet Örken bridged across, but the pair were caught with 3 km to go. In the sprint, Davide Ballerini took the win ahead of Bogusławski and Crabbe.
